news.title: Netris raises $15M Series A from a16z to help AI neoclouds go live faster
news.description: Netris provides software that runs on network switches, and offers a platform that helps neocloud operators reduce the time it takes to go live.

news.title: Amazon ups India bet with fresh $13B AI infrastructure investment
news.description: Amazon’s latest India investment comes as global tech companies race to expand AI infrastructure in the country.

news.title: IBM hails new 'block of flats' design breakthrough for ultra tiny chips
news.description: IBM says it has created the world's first known chip tech below 1 nanometre - but it will be some time before it's ready for production.

news.title: GTA 6 will cost £70 - and physical edition will not contain a disc
news.description: Rockstar has said physical copies of the game will contain a code for a digital download for the game.

news.title: Scientist publishes fresh doubts over Microsoft's quantum claims
news.description: The tech giant has consistently stood by its Majorana chip research despite scepticism from some experts in the field.

news.title: World Cup Teams Are in a Race for AI Dominance
news.description: This year, FIFA is providing an AI agent that any team can use. Is it enough to level the playing field or will future winners be determined by which team can afford the best tools?

news.title: How to Opt Out of Google Search’s New AI Data Training Feature
news.description: Google’s Search history update stores media uploads from your interactions, like images used in reverse image searches, for training its AI models.

news.title: A24 Knows You’re Mad About the Google AI Collab
news.description: Indie movie fans are upset about Google DeepMind’s $75 million investment in the studio, which comes as AI companies are deepening their influence in Hollywood.
